features.name: Search → Play
steps: Enter a track keyword in Search
Inspect mixed results containing tracks, artists, albums, and playlists
Select the intended track
Start playback
Verify the global player updates with track title, artist, artwork, duration, and progress
Navigate away from Search while playback continues
features.expected: Mixed search results must include tracks, artists, albums, and playlists; selected track starts playback; global player shows title, artist, artwork, duration, and progress; playback continues after navigating away.

features.name: Search Categories
steps: Search for a keyword
Switch between result scopes such as All, Songs, Artists, Playlists, Albums, Podcasts/Audiobooks where supported
Open an item from a filtered result
Return to Search
Preserve the query and current search context
features.expected: Result scopes must filter correctly; opening a filtered item and returning preserves the query and search context.

features.name: Playback Controls
steps: Start a track
Pause and resume playback
Seek to another timestamp
Move to the next or previous track
Toggle shuffle and repeat
Continue navigating through Spotify
Preserve the currently playing track and playback state in the persistent bottom player
features.expected: Pause/resume, seek, next/previous, shuffle/repeat must all work; current track and playback state persist in the bottom player while navigating.

features.name: Queue
steps: Start playing a track
Add another track to the play queue
Open Queue
Verify the current track and upcoming tracks
Advance playback
The queued track becomes current and the remaining queue updates consistently
features.expected: Queued track must appear in Queue; after advancing, it becomes current and the remaining queue updates consistently.

features.name: Create Playlist
steps: Create a new playlist from Your Library
Open the playlist
Search for tracks from inside the playlist
Add multiple tracks
Verify they appear in the playlist and the library sidebar
Leave the playlist and reopen it
Preserve playlist membership and track order
features.expected: New playlist must accept multiple added tracks; membership and track order persist after leaving and reopening.

features.name: Manage Playlist
steps: Open an existing playlist
Edit playlist details where supported
Remove a track
Add another track
Use playlist actions such as privacy/profile visibility where available
Reopen the playlist
Confirm the updated metadata and track collection persist
features.expected: Playlist edits (details, remove/add tracks, visibility) must persist after reopening.

features.name: Playlist Folder
steps: Create a playlist folder
Move an existing playlist into the folder
Return to Your Library
Expand the folder and reopen the playlist
Move or remove the playlist from the folder
Verify the playlist itself remains intact while only its library organization changes
features.expected: Folder must contain the moved playlist; expanding reopens it; removing from folder leaves the playlist itself intact.

features.name: Track Library State
steps: Open a track from Search, Browse, or a playlist
Add/save it to the user's library or liked collection where supported
Navigate to another surface
Return to the track
Saved state remains visible
Remove it again
Verify the library state updates without affecting the original catalog item
features.expected: Saved state must persist across surfaces; removing updates the library state without affecting the original catalog item.

features.name: Artist / Album Navigation
steps: Open a track
Navigate to its artist or album through track details/context actions
Inspect the artist/album content
Start another track from that page
Return to the previous surface
Global playback continues independently from page navigation
features.expected: Artist/album navigation from a track must work; starting another track there keeps global playback independent of page navigation.

features.name: Recently Played
steps: Play tracks or playlists from multiple locations
Open Recently Played
Verify recently accessed content appears in recency order
Reopen an item from history
Continue playback
Return again and confirm the recent activity state has been updated
features.expected: Recently Played must list content in recency order; reopening updates the recent activity state.

features.name: Browse → Playback
steps: Open Browse All
Enter a seeded category such as Pop, Focus, Workout, Sleep, or Charts
Open a playlist or album
Start a track
Return to Browse
Open another category
Current player state remains active while navigation context changes
features.expected: Category browsing must open seeded playlists/albums; starting a track keeps player state active while navigation context changes.

features.name: Cross-Surface Music Session
steps: Search for Track A
Play it
Add Track B to the queue
Add Track A and Track C to Playlist X
Navigate to Browse and start Track D
Return to Playlist X
Verify A and C are still present
Open Queue and verify queue state according to intervening playback actions
Return to Search or Recently Played
All library, playlist, queue, and global player states remain mutually consistent
features.expected: All library, playlist, queue, and global player states must remain mutually consistent across the multi-surface session.

exclusions.feature:
Real Spotify music catalog
Do not require the replica to contain Spotify's real worldwide catalog, exact search ranking, artist popularity counts, release availability, or market-specific catalog state
exclusions.reason: External licensed dataset; use a frozen synthetic catalog instead

exclusions.feature:
Real copyrighted audio streaming
Do not require full Spotify tracks, DRM, Spotify CDN playback, Premium playback authorization, or Spotify Connect
exclusions.reason: Requires licensed audio, account state, and external playback infrastructure

exclusions.feature:
Real lyrics / synchronized lyrics
Do not require Spotify's real lyric provider, exact lyric text, or timestamp synchronization
exclusions.reason: Copyrighted/external dataset; synthetic fixture lyrics may be used only if playback UI needs testing

exclusions.feature:
Recommendation / personalization engine
Exclude Discover Weekly, Daily Mix, personalized Home ranking, “Made for You”, recommended tracks, recommendation learning, and user-specific ranking
exclusions.reason: Requires large-scale recommendation models and private behavioral data

exclusions.feature:
Dynamic charts and editorial ranking
Do not require real Top 50, Viral, trending, new-release, regional chart, or editorial ranking data to match Spotify
exclusions.reason: Continuously changing external data; use seeded static category content

exclusions.feature:
Radio / Autoplay recommendation generation
Exclude generating artist radio, song radio, endless autoplay, recommendation chains, or algorithmic next-track selection
exclusions.reason: Recommendation-system dependency

exclusions.feature:
Music videos / Canvas / video content
Exclude MV playback, Canvas looping video, creator videos, and external video delivery
exclusions.reason: Separate media pipeline and licensed video assets

exclusions.feature:
Podcasts / Audiobooks / Live Events
Do not require complete podcast, audiobook, concert, or live-event ecosystems unless a separate benchmark explicitly targets them
exclusions.reason: Separate product domains rather than the core music-player benchmark

exclusions.feature:
Premium / Subscription / Billing
Exclude Premium upgrades, trials, plans, billing, checkout, payment methods, subscription state, and plan-specific restrictions
exclusions.reason: Commerce infrastructure is unrelated to core music interaction

exclusions.feature:
Offline download
Exclude downloading encrypted tracks for offline playback, device storage limits, and download synchronization
exclusions.reason: Requires native client, DRM, storage, and licensed content

exclusions.feature:
Spotify Connect / Device handoff
Exclude discovering physical devices, transferring playback between browser/mobile/speaker, remote device control, and multi-device synchronization
exclusions.reason: Requires real devices and external Spotify infrastructure

exclusions.feature:
Social / Friends
Exclude Friend Activity, follower graphs, social presence, listening activity visibility, profile-based recommendation, and friend discovery
exclusions.reason: Social graph and multi-user infrastructure

exclusions.feature:
Collaborative Playlist / Jam / Blend
Exclude real-time playlist collaboration, invitations, shared listening sessions, Blend, Jam, and synchronized multiplayer playback
exclusions.reason: Requires multi-user and realtime collaboration infrastructure

exclusions.feature:
Sharing outside the replica
Exclude external share sheets, social-network publishing, messaging apps, public Spotify URLs, QR/Spotify Codes, and deep-link interoperability
exclusions.reason: Third-party integration rather than core app state

exclusions.feature:
Real artist follow ecosystem
Following an artist may be represented as a local boolean if useful, but do not require real follower counts, artist notifications, fan analytics, or artist-profile social state
exclusions.reason: External social/content infrastructure

exclusions.feature:
Notifications
Exclude release alerts, push notifications, email notifications, followed-artist updates, and notification delivery
exclusions.reason: Requires asynchronous notification infrastructure

exclusions.feature:
Account / Authentication complexity
Do not benchmark signup, login recovery, MFA, account linking, region migration, password management, account deletion, or session security
exclusions.reason: Identity infrastructure rather than music-product behavior

exclusions.feature:
Desktop application integration
Exclude “Open in desktop app”, installer flows, OS media keys, native Windows/macOS audio enhancements, system equalizer integration, and desktop-specific controls
exclusions.reason: Depends on native OS capabilities

exclusions.feature:
Audio quality / normalization / equalizer internals
Settings UI may be visually reproduced, but do not require real codec switching, loudness normalization algorithms, EQ DSP, lossless delivery, or hardware-specific audio processing
exclusions.reason: Requires real audio pipeline/DSP rather than frontend interaction

exclusions.feature:
Advertisements
Exclude ad targeting, ad insertion, frequency capping, sponsored recommendations, and ad measurement
exclusions.reason: Advertising infrastructure and targeting data

exclusions.feature:
AI features
Exclude AI DJ, AI Playlist, generated recommendations, conversational music discovery, or any generative Spotify feature
exclusions.reason: Requires unavailable model/service dependencies

exclusions.feature:
Exact Spotify metadata and artwork
Do not score whether artist biographies, monthly listener counts, album covers, editorial descriptions, credits, or related-MV cards exactly match production Spotify
exclusions.reason: Benchmark should evaluate interaction logic, not proprietary content parity
